title: consolidated metadata does not capture differently-cased keys
body:
### Zarr version

3.3.0

### Numcodecs version

0.16.5

### Python Version

3.14

### Operating System

Mac

### Installation

pip

### Description

Consolidated metadata does not respect case-sensitivity, it seems?

### Steps to reproduce

```python
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = [
#   "zarr@git+https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python.git@main",
# ]
# ///
#
# This script automatically imports the development branch of zarr to check for issues

import zarr
import numpy as np

z = zarr.open("foo.zarr", mode="w")
z["bar"] = np.array([0, 1])
z["Bar"] = np.array([1, 2])
zarr.consolidate_metadata(z.store)
z = zarr.open_consolidated("foo.zarr")
assert "bar" not in z
z["bar"] # raises error, see issue for traceback
```
